name: Ground Truth
tagline: Your dirt has opinions. We translate them.
positioning: Soil analytics for owner-operators who'd rather run a farm than a spreadsheet. Real lab-grade readings, plain-English answers, zero agronomy degree required.

hero.h1: Stop guessing what your dirt is thinking.
hero.sub: Ground Truth turns a fistful of soil into lab-grade nitrogen, pH, and moisture readings — then tells you what to actually do, in words a human uses. No agronomist on retainer required.

features.title: Readings, not riddles
features.description: Every sample comes back with numbers and a one-line verdict. "Too much nitrogen, ease off the fertilizer" beats a 40-page PDF you'll never open.

features.title: Field-map your whole operation
features.description: Pin samples to exact spots on your land. Watch a heat map fill in over seasons so you stop over-treating the acre that was always fine.

features.title: Reminders that respect your time
features.description: We nudge you when a plot is due for a retest — not at 5am, not fourteen times, not with a motivational quote about soil.

features.title: Trends since your granddad
features.description: Import old records or start fresh. Either way you get year-over-year lines that make bankers and landlords nod approvingly.

features.title: Works where signal doesn't
features.description: Log samples offline in the back forty. Everything syncs the second you're near a bar of reception or the barn wifi.

features.title: Share without oversharing
features.description: Send a clean report to your co-op or agronomist with one link. They see the data, not your login, not your other fields.

testimonials.quote: I used to mail samples to a lab and wait three weeks for a spreadsheet I couldn't read. Now I scan, I get an answer, I move on. My cover crop actually made sense this year.
testimonials.name: Dale Ferris

testimonials.quote: We manage 22 acres of vines across four slopes with wildly different soil. Ground Truth's field map showed me I'd been fertilizing block three like block one for a decade. Rookie mistake, fixed.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghunathan

testimonials.quote: The reminders are the whole thing for me. I forget to test until something's already yellow. Now it just tells me. Dry sense of humor too, which I did not expect from a soil app.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitlow

pricing.blurb: For the solo operator with a truck, a shovel, and better things to do.
For growing operations juggling crews, seasons, and picky landlords.
For co-ops and multi-site operations that answer to a board.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ground Truth reads your soil so you don't have to squint at a chart. Test smarter, treat less, keep the good dirt good.
